$comment: Per-repo settings for the usiatech-engineering plugin. Copy to .claude/engineering.json and adjust.

governance.$comment: Guard settings. Commands are case-insensitive regexes. Defaults already cover destructive git/SQL/rm, curl|sh, --no-verify, dependency adds, remote/infra commands, secrets reads and sudo. allowlist suppresses one workflow/dependency finding by rule ID plus a path glob or package name (still reported, never blocks), e.g. {"rule": "wf-unpinned-action", "path": ".github/workflows/pr-governance.yml", "reason": "..."}; it ships empty. approvalLabel and requirementRefPattern (null = default C-number/FR/AC/ADR/D-item/§/#issue) are also used by the PR governance workflow.
